statistic.purpose: A fan's speed and its RPM unit, in IBM Plex Mono.

motion.name: standard
motion.purpose: A panel or a section that appears.

narrative.overview: AirFlow is a translucent window. The desktop shows through it, and every component on it is a pane of Liquid Glass. The components are Ant Design's, and color has one job, which is temperature.
keyCharacteristics: A translucent window with glass components, and no card inside a card.
Ant Design's outlined icons at one weight, and one mark, the fan.
A five-step temperature scale that always sits beside a number.
Hedvig Letters Sans for text, and IBM Plex Mono for every reading.
Motion that shows a state: a rotor turns as fast as its fan.

rules.name: The Number Rule
rules.body: A temperature color never appears alone.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent means selected or acts. It never decorates.

dos: Draw components through antGlass, GlassCard, StateTag, and StatusBanner.
Root every page in a ScrollView or a Table.
donts: Don't put a card inside a card.
Don't use a temperature color without its number.
Don't use SF Symbols in AirFlow's own views.
